name: Wand of Binding
description: A short wand of black iron wrapped in a fine chain.
body:
## What it does

Spend its charges to hold a creature where it stands. It also helps you slip free of being held yourself.

## Charges

It holds seven and regains 1d6 + 1 each dawn. Spend the last and it may crumble to ash.

features.name: Assisted Escape
features.text: 1 charge, as a reaction: advantage on a save against being paralyzed or restrained. 1 charge: advantage on a check to escape a grapple.

charges.last: roll a d20; on a 1 it crumbles to ash
